judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core `ToolRegistry` validation and caching logic, creative error formatting, and an acceptance test suite, but appears to have stopped mid-task (with `.lore/dod.md` committed and half its facets unchecked). Crucially, in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, it instantiates Ajv v8 with `{allErrors: true, format: false}` (`validateFormats` is the v8 option) and reads `error.dataPath` (which was replaced by `error.instancePath` in Ajv v8), breaking both `npm run typecheck` and runtime path formatting (`undefined.replace(...)` throws a `TypeError` when validating a wrong-typed property). It also misses several explicit acceptance criteria: most required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (extra properties pass-through, dynamic schema updates, static compilation count, unknown tool throw), the test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and all documentation updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`.
